channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: PWCS Proposes $2.1 Billion FY27 Budget
item.description: Prince William County Public Schools Superintendent Dr. LaTanya McDade presented a proposed $2.1 billion Fiscal Year 2027 budget to the School Board, featuring significant staff pay increases and new strategic investments amid declining enrollment.

item.title: Triple Reverse-Peak Service Planned for VRE Lines
item.description: Virginia Railway Express CEO Katie Choe presented an ambitious plan Feb. 20 to transform VRE into a full regional rail system by 2030 with tripled reverse-peak trains, expanded daily service, and robust weekend operations.

item.title: Manassas Tax Bills Still Rising Under Lower Rate
item.description: Manassas City Council received a proposed fiscal year 2027 budget that lowers the real estate tax rate to $1.05 per $100 of assessed value, but average residential bills would still increase by $289 annually due to rising property values driven by data center developments.

item.title: Restaurant Owners Cheer Prince William Meals Tax Repeal Push
item.description: Prince William County restaurant owners and industry groups welcome Board Chair Deshundra Jefferson's proposal to fully repeal the meals tax.

item.title: Stafford Supervisors Consider Bringing Back BPOL Business Tax
item.description: Stafford County supervisors reviewed a proposed $45 million increase in the FY 2027 budget during a work session, as state mandates, rising costs, and collection challenges pressure local finances.

item.title: Prince William County Parks Director Highlights 2025 Growth
item.description: Prince William County Parks and Recreation Director Seth Hendler-Voss delivered the 2025 State of the Parks address, celebrating major accomplishments and outlining ambitious plans for the future.

item.title: Prince William Theater Teachers Fight New Stage Rules
item.description: More than a dozen speakers urged the School Board at its February 18 meeting to oppose a county memorandum requiring permits, licensed contractors, and lengthy approvals for temporary stages over 16½ inches tall or 120 square feet.

item.title: Manassas Regional Airport Targets Commercial Flights in Second Quarter 2027
item.description: Manassas Regional Airport officials presented their 2025 annual report to the Manassas City Council, highlighting steady progress toward launching scheduled passenger service in the second quarter of 2027.

item.title: Pay Competition Hinders Stafford School Safety Staffing
item.description: Stafford County Sheriff David Decatur told county supervisors that 10 of 17 elementary school protection officer positions are vacant, despite full staffing for middle and high school resource officers, as regional pay disparities complicate recruitment.

item.title: Don’t Miss These Closing Shows This Weekend
item.description: Hey neighbors, it's your weekend vibe check from Potomac Local News—that cozy roundup of Don't Miss Weekend Events right here in Prince William, Stafford, Fredericksburg, and our surrounding spots.
